# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplemental assessment artifacts generated during analysis.

- [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture views with Mermaid diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) - Declared package dependencies categorized by function and risk notes.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, communication patterns, and sequence diagram.
- [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, ownership boundaries, and data sensitivity notes.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, properties, and secret handling inventory.
- [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business flows, decision logic, and workflow sequence diagram.
